final: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS film_count FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), total AS (SELECT SUM(film_count) AS total_count FROM rating_counts), shares AS (SELECT rc.rating, rc.film_count, 1.0 * rc.film_count / t.total_count AS share FROM rating_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares), above_mean AS (SELECT s.film_count, s.share, s.share - m.value AS excess FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN mean_share AS m WHERE m.value IS NOT NULL AND s.share > m.value) SELECT SUM(film_count), AVG(share), AVG(excess) FROM above_mean
